metadata.title: Small Planets in the Galactic Context: Host Star Kinematics, Iron, and $α$ Element Enhancement

notes: No individual star is identified as a Galactic unbound candidate. The paper's kinematic discussion concerns thin- and thick-disk populations and uses total velocity up to 120–180 km/s without equating high velocity with being unbound from the Milky Way; the planet hosts are analyzed only as statistical samples.
